entry.title: Accommodation
entry.content:
The venue is in the centre of Katowice, so there are plenty of hotels within walking distance. Here are some options, from right next door to a short walk away. Walking times are approximate.

Player discounts: we are asking several of these hotels for discount codes for ERMC players. Codes will be added to the hotels below as soon as we have them. We still recommend booking early.

In the venue complex

Hotel Diament Spodek

Inside the Spodek building, a couple of minutes’ walk from the playing hall. A simple three-star hotel with 30 rooms. Parking is available on site but must be booked in advance.

al. Korfantego 35

Hotel website

Around 10 minutes’ walk

voco Katowice

Modern hotel with a restaurant, gym and pool, about 10 minutes’ walk from the venue.

al. Korfantego 9

Hotel website

Courtyard by Marriott Katowice City Center

High-rise hotel with city views and a top-floor restaurant, about 10 minutes’ walk from the venue.

ul. Uniwersytecka 13

Hotel website

Novotel Katowice Centrum

Large hotel with a pool and sauna, about 12 minutes’ walk from the venue.

al. Roździeńskiego 16

Hotel website

ibis budget Katowice Centrum

The budget option, next door to the Novotel and about 12 minutes’ walk from the venue. The airport bus stops right by the hotel.

al. Roździeńskiego 18

Hotel website

In the city centre

Vienna House Easy by Wyndham Katowice

Modern hotel close to the city centre, about 15 minutes’ walk from the venue.

ul. Sokolska 24

Hotel website

Hotel Monopol

Historic five-star hotel from 1902 with a spa and pool, near the main railway station and about 15–20 minutes’ walk from the venue.

ul. Dworcowa 5

Hotel website

There are many more hotels and apartments in the city centre. Anywhere near Katowice railway station or the Rondo roundabout is within easy reach of the venue on foot or by tram. See Getting to Katowice for details.

entry.title: Getting to Katowice
entry.content:
ERMC 2027 takes place in Katowice, in southern Poland. The city is well connected by air, rail and road, and the venue is in the city centre, a short walk from the main railway station.

Timetables and prices change, so please check the operators’ websites before you travel.

By plane

Katowice Airport (KTW) in Pyrzowice is about 34 km north of the city centre and has connections to destinations across Europe. Airport buses run to the centre and take about 45 minutes; a taxi takes around 40 minutes. See the airport’s website for current bus options.

Kraków Airport (KRK) has even more connections and is about 80 km from Katowice. Direct buses go from the airport to Katowice in roughly an hour. Alternatively, take the airport train to Kraków Główny and change there for Katowice, which takes around two hours in total. By car the trip is about an hour.

Ostrava Airport (OSR) in the Czech Republic is about 130 km away, around 1 hour 15 minutes by car. From Ostrava there are direct trains and buses to Katowice, taking about 1.5 hours.

By train

Katowice is the city’s main railway station, in the centre, about 15 minutes’ walk from the venue.

  • From Kraków: about 1 hour 10 minutes, with frequent trains.
  • From Warsaw: about 2.5–3 hours.
  • International: Katowice has direct trains to several other countries, including Germany, the Czech Republic, Austria and Hungary.

Tickets and timetables for all Polish rail operators are on koleo.pl.

By bus

Long-distance buses, such as FlixBus, arrive at the Katowice bus station, about 5 minutes’ walk from the main railway station and around 20 minutes’ walk from the venue.

By car

Katowice sits at the junction of the A4 (east–west) and A1 (north–south) motorways. The venue has its own car park with around 1,500 spaces.

Getting around Katowice

From the main railway station you can walk to the venue in about 15 minutes, or take a tram a few stops to Katowice Rondo. Other nearby stops are Katowice Spodek and Katowice Uniwersytecka.

Trams and buses are run by the regional transport authority (ZTM). Plan your journey and buy tickets with the Jakdojade app, or check timetables at rj.metropoliaztm.pl. Taxis and ride-hailing apps such as Uber and Bolt are also available.
entry.summary: ERMC 2027 takes place in Katowice, in southern Poland. The city is well connected by air, rail and road, and the venue is in the city centre, a short walk from the main railway station.
